description: One place to follow up. With a `bookingId` from book: whether the business accepted, declined or finished it. With an `errandId` from find_and_ask: who has accepted, declined or not answered. Without either, when the user connected their Foundaree account: the booking requests people sent them, and the bookings for businesses they own, and which are still waiting for an answer.
name: check
title: Check on what you started
